Era XI · The Expedition to the End
As they dug on, they uncovered a strange frame of obsidian.
Twelve blocks, hollow in the middle.
Above the frame ran a row of sockets,
each one exactly the size of an eye of ender.
this was a doorway into another dimension.
They decided — to leave this world.
Not because there was no hope left, but because hope had grown too wearying.
The Undead Rot, the Warlocks' attacks, the Echo Sentinel's loss of control —
each of them was draining the Builders away.
They set their hope on the End —
that void, that emptiness, that place with no Undead Rot in it.
One by one they set the eyes of ender into the frame.
purple, a purple deeper than the Nether's.
The first of the Builders walked through.
